audit.whatIsWrong: Level-2 text said 'Three turrets' and gave no Twilight Shroud number; trading lines used male pronouns for Akali.
audit.why: Two H-28G charges exist at level 2. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, which is the timer the whole lane is traded around.
audit.corrected: Two turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Trade when Twilight Shroud is down — it is 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and 2+ items were both marked as Heimerdinger wins while the whys text on the same rows said the opposite ('her kill window, not yours', 'hand her off to your team').
audit.why: Perfect Execution (120/90/60) is two dashes with an execute on the recast and Heimerdinger has no dash; Lich Bane plus Shadowflame bursts him through the nest. The page rendered two answers to the same row.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and 2+ items now read Akali on both layers, with ratings dropped to 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' in four places and the H-28G turret's secondary beam was described as slowing.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970 range) — it stuns a direct hit and slows around the impact. Riot's turret text describes a pass-through beam with no slow. Twilight Shroud makes her 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so turret beams drop lock while she is inside.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is your only hard CC — spend it on her Shuriken Flip commit before Shroud goes down, never into the smoke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Akali's burst opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Assassin's Mark empowers her next attack with bonus range after she leaves the ring — the auto wind-up, not the ability cast, is the tell.
audit.corrected: Step back on her empowered auto wind-up rather than on her Q cast.
